pages.title: Chain
pages.text:
$(l)double, double, vec3/entity -> Chain -> List$()
Parameter reading order: max chain distance, max jumps, start coordinate or entity

Based on stack LIFO rule, input order should be reversed from reading order.
Chain query based on start type: $(br)• If start is coordinate, returns list of all connected block positions (adjacent same type, max distance is placeholder), up to "max jumps" results.
• If start is entity, returns entity list jumping within "max chain distance", ignores caster and item entities, up to "max jumps" entities.
